name: Unique Splash
body:
Your talent with bombs also extends to other alchemical items.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemy class feature, 1 or more [shape] discoveries.

Benefit(s): Whenever you spend 1 quintessence to increase the damage of an alchemical splash weapon, you can also apply a [shape] discovery to it as though it was a bomb, paying any associated quintessence cost the discovery may have.
